page_titles.title: Catalog Data
page_titles.subtitle: Back up, restore and transfer the whole catalog module as a single JSON file.

labels.import_description: Restore or transfer catalog data from a module export file.
labels.duplicate_strategy: Existing records with the same key (code, slug or SKU)
labels.row_cap_exceeded: The file exceeds the {{cap}} row limit.
labels.history_description: Past module import runs, latest first.

help_texts.import: Pick a JSON file produced by the export on this or another store. Sections are imported in dependency order; rows matching existing records follow the duplicate strategy.
help_texts.export: Downloads every product, category, attribute and option with all translations as a lossless JSON backup you can re-import on any store.
help_texts.dry_run: Validates every row and reports the outcome without writing anything.
